lead.t: Look for a prominent *v* wave if functional tricuspid regurgitation is present, or a positive Kussmaul sign (paradoxical rise in JVP on inspiration) typical of restrictive cardiomyopathy (RCM).

b: Endomyocardial fibrosis, granulomatous deposition, or iron overload $\rightarrow$ Massive accumulation of fibrotic tissue or abnormal proteins within the myocardial interstitium $\rightarrow$ Rigid, non-compliant ventricular myocardium $\ri
Stiff, non-compliant ventricles → diastolic dysfunction , normal EF
Amyloidosis — most common in developed world; "sparkling" on echo
Endomyocardial fibrosis — most common worldwide (tropical Africa)
